title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail the size of a teacup, she glides in slow, looping waltzes across a moonlit tank of indigo water, pausing to hum soft bubbles into the glow of lantern-like sea moss. Her shell is a tiny spun-glass lighthouse that blinks gently whenever she's pleased, which is nearly always.
